summary: First E2E backend + frontend test run for Sapiens Anotador Cognitivo. All 14 backend pytest tests passed (ontology, pipeline CRUD, artifacts, regenerate). All frontend flows validated: sidebar nav, Ontology page (seed 1.0.0-seed, 8/16/28/13/7 counts, expandable sections + item descriptions), Pipeline Generator (dropzone, hidden file input, disabled→enabled generate btn, busy-hint loading state), Questoes page (filters + apply). Gemini 3 Pro classification returned only valid ontology IDs (DOM-*/COMP-*/PROC-*) as required.
critical_code_review_comments: Backend server.py at ~450 lines is fine. All endpoints properly async, use uuid ids, exclude _id from responses.
storage.py: init_storage() lacks retry/lock protection but is called once at startup — acceptable.
cognitive_engine.py correctly uses emergentintegrations LlmChat + FileContentWithMimeType with gemini-3.1-pro-preview and strict JSON prompt.
Frontend: PipelineGenerator uses a hidden file input by design — tests should not wait_for_selector visible on it (informational note).
ontology import endpoint doesn't validate structure beyond parsing; a malformed but well-parsed doc could become active. Non-blocking.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create/delete their own pipelines using a small reportlab-generated PDF; a TEST-1.0 ontology is imported and seed 1.0.0-seed is reactivated afterwards (no residual state).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py exercises all 14 endpoints end-to-end and takes ~55s (two Gemini generations). Real LLM used (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). Reportlab is installed. Frontend hidden file inputs (ontology-file-input, pipeline-file-input) must be interacted via set_input_files without waiting for visibility.
